v0.6.0-beta.description:
# RE4R Archipelago v0.6.0-beta

Merchant Trade support, including a reworked AP Check/refund economy, Mercenaries Mode support, launcher improvements to get ready for Separate Ways, dozens of bug fixes, and officially leaving Alpha (now in Beta)

**This release needs a new seed.** Rooms generated on 0.5.0 name locations this
build no longer has.

## The Archipelago Merchant

### General
- Various updates to the models, icons, names, and descriptions to make RE4R items look nicer, while still making it clear they are AP Checks.

### Buy Tab Tweaks
- Checks now cost 2500 / 7500 / 15000 by tier
- Buying another Player (or Game) item will refund you 1 / 3 / 6 Spinel by tier


### Trade Tab Support
- Spinels can now purchase AP Checks, with 3 per chapter (45 total)
- Spinel cost is determined by the tier price of the item
- The World now spawns in exactly enough Spinel to pay for all Checks (but not the Gems)
- Merchant Requests will still give you extra Spinel (84 in the campaign)
- Trade AP Checks will not refund you anything
- Velvet Blue is infinitely claimable, offering a quick return on cash at a slight loss of value
- Gems restock frequently, offering a longer-term investment opportunity for high ROI slottable Treasures
- The Merchants vanilla Trade stock joins the AP Pool, just like the Buy tab stock

## The Mercenaries
A massive shoutout to @snowzzrra for this entire implementation; it’s a lot of fun and a great addition to RE4R AP!

- When setting up your seed in the Wizard, add Mercenaries in the new “Included Content” section
- Checks are earned by achieving Ranks in Mercenaries
- In the Wizard, customize “Ranks as Checks” with a slider and two markers for the lowest and highest Ranks to be included. Default: Rank C - Rank A, with all Stages & Characters; that’s 96 Checks.
- Start with one Stage and one Character
- Mercenaries AP by itself requires no BioRand patching
- Characters & Stages that are locked/unlocked by Archipelago respect the proper visuals
- The vanilla Stage Results have been overwritten with unlocked AP Checks instead

## Gear & AP Pool
- Weapon Randomization is now a single three-way picker to prevent some patching failures
- Knives & Case Upgrades are now Progressive. Whenever you receive one, you’ll get the next upgrade in the path rather than a specific one.
- Handcannon, Chicago Sweeper, and Primal Knife are now ordinary items in every seed, and “Allow Bonus Weapons” is no longer required (No more tampering with saves, yay!)
- Guns in your Starting Arsenal now have a chance to spawn with supported attachments. If it's a scope-supported weapon, it has a 100% chance to spawn with one.
- Body Armour is now in the Pool
- Pesetas x5000 can now spawn in the Pool

## Keys, Logic, & Generation
- Tweaks to Small Key logic to preserve the intended & expected behaviour
- Improvements to ensure Ashley can always receive and use her two Key items regardless of when they get grabbed
- Chapter 16 is now limited to Filler & Useful items only
- Various Logic corrections from playtest reports
- Various YAML changes to mitigate generation failures
- Unlocked Typewriters now accept names as well as IDs
- Generation failures will more frequently name the fix, instead of being useless & unhelpful

## The Welcome Note
- The Welcome Note now exists, replacing the old tutorial
- It rests on a metal chest in front and to the right of Leon right as he spawns, and covers everything you might want to know about the RE4R AP mod

## REFramework Archipelago Window
- You can now hide the “Multiworld Hints” overlay under “Guidance”
- Visual & organizational improvements
- The Checklist was reworked to support Mercenaries and (in the future) Separate Ways
- New “Customize” tab to… customize the window colours (no more white, grey, and black, yay!)
- Various new dev tools

## Deliveries & Checks
- Inventory will now try rotating an object to see if it fits, before sending it to Storage if it doesn’t
- Checks will send, even if your inventory is full
- “Force Check” also clears the associated Marker
- Placeholder items for purchases of remote AP checks should now always be removed
- Item delivery was built for Ada in Separate Ways (still unreleased)

## The Wizard
- Various bug fixes
- New “Included Content” section
- Included content dictates what YAML settings are shown
- The bundled REFramework build has been updated
- Improved BioRand failure errors
- Improved Bug Report Generation
- Improved detection of a “poisoned” BioRand cache
- Fixed patching issue on Hardcore/Professional difficulty seeds
